{{Quote|What do you think you're doing here? This my factory! No trespassers!|[[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]]|<ref name="SWG:IG88" />}}
The '''Battle of Nym's Factory Compound''' occurred in [[Nym's Factory Compound]] on [[Lok/Legends|Lok]] in [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==Background==
The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[IG-88B/Legends|IG-88]] had set up production of droids for its [[IG-88's Droid Army|droid army]] in the compound and a group of [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] came to shut things down.

==The battle==
{{Quote|Keep in memory buffers that my factories can produce unlimited droidekas such as these!|IG-88|<ref name="SWG:IG88" />}}
As the spacers entered the compound, a number of exploding [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s confronted them in the entrance, but were defeated. The spacers pushed on and faced down two waves of four gold [[Droideka/Legends|droidekas]]. The spacers then faced a serious threat, from giant B1s equipped with [[Flamethrower/Legends|flamethrowers]], to [[MSE-6 series repair droid/Legends|MSE-6-series repair droids]] that targeted their artillery barrages. Eventually the spacers prevailed again and defeated the droids.

The spacers had a final showdown with the IG-88 droid commanding the facility, which was armed with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] and a flamethrower and fought ferociously. Ultimately though, it was defeated and the factory was shut down.

==Aftermath==
The remains of the IG-88 droid were presumably recovered and repaired by IG-88's droid army, as all four IG-88 droids were known to have been sighted at later dates.

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Nym's Factory Compound appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IG88" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> It was one of the "[[W:c:swg:Category:Heroic_instances|Heroic Encounters]]" that were introduced to the game in the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|Chapter 7]],"<ref name="SWG:IG88" /> released on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
